message: 最近は緩みがち

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Riesling-san.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Good day to you, Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where are you headed today?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I was granted the day off today, so I was just out foraging for wild mountain vegetables.」

name: Synn
message: 「What were those called again? Those expensive things called 'truffles' or whatever?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No. They are royal fern shoots and wood ear mushrooms.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, pretty ordinary.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am humbled.」
I wonder if she realizes how unusual that actually is.

name: Riesling
message: 「Are you not going out with the young lady today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--\s01 I-It's not like I'm with Lolotte... every single day or anything...\s03」

name: Riesling
message: 「Heehee...」
Riesling-san is laughing.

name: Riesling
message: 「Is it truly so rare for the likes of me, Riesling Tooyama, to laugh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please do not mind it. Even I feel a sense of unfamiliarity with it from time to time.」
Riesling-san gazes up at the sky.

name: Riesling
message: 「Master Synn. Might I trouble you... for just a moment of your time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Welcome♪ Welcome to Chocolat l'Or! What may I get for your order?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Just ice water.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Two pure chocolate cakes and two royal milk teas, please.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Your usual, then. Certainly. Please wait just a moment.」

name: Riesling
message: 「The other set is for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes. Since I, Riesling Tooyama, invited you, treating you to at least this much is only proper」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry... for everything you've done」

name: Riesling
message: 「Besides, I wouldn't want you to think of me as a glutton」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I don't think that at all!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Riesling
message: 「I, too... only became able to smile after meeting Milady」

name: Riesling
message: 「I imagine you have heard bits and pieces here and there, but I used to be a mercenary」

name: Riesling
message: 「Stepping onto battlefields and taking lives for a living. It was during one of those missions that I met Helena」

name: Synn
message: 「With Helena...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「And then I suffered the first failure of my life, suddenly finding myself hunted by the Syndicate」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You've really had a turbulent life」

name: Riesling
message: 「The ones who saved me from that were Helena... and Melilot. After seeking asylum in this country, the two of them gave me a job protecting people」

name: Synn
message: 「Was that being Lolotte's bodyguard?」

name: Riesling
message: 「To be precise, a bodyguard for the Rosenkreuz family. It was a little while later that I began serving as Milady's butler」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, I was a killing machine modified to be cold-blooded and composed」

name: Riesling
message: 「Without opening my heart even to Helena or Melilot, I lived a life of simply carrying out my duties faithfully」

name: Riesling
message: 「Heartless... I was an empty shell of a soul all along」

name: Riesling
message: 「Until I met Milady」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have heard that the more sublime an angel is, the less of a heart it possesses」

name: Riesling
message: 「Because a heart gives birth to malice. To ensure one does only what is right, emotions are unnecessary」

name: Riesling
message: 「Perhaps from Milady's perspective, even I looked like an angel who had lost her emotions.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady taught someone like me what it means to have a heart.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Don't you think Azel-sama has also become much more expressive lately?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, y-yes. Indeed.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Indeed. When everyone around her is expressionless, it's no wonder Milady grew bored.」

name: Riesling
message: 「And so she ventured to the Human World and met you, Synn-sama.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady looks truly happy now. She talks until she falls asleep about how fulfilling every day spent with you is.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's... I'm not really doing anything special or anything.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please continue to take good care of Milady.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop that! Please don't bow your head like that...!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehe... Could this be what it feels like to send one's own daughter off to be married, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Married!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「For a servant like me to make such a lighthearted jest... Even I can scarcely believe it.」
Riesling-san kept a gentle smile on her face the entire time she spoke.
It was a truly wonderful smile.

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, our break is almost over. It's about time we composed our relaxed expressions.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Thank you for waiting. Here is your Pure Chocolate Cake.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, there's no need to compose ourselves just to eat cake--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please, go ahead and eat.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the food~ *nom*」

name: Synn
message: 「Bitter!!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It's our shop's pride and joy, a dessert prized for its bitterness so you can enjoy the pure flavor of cacao♪」
And once again, Riesling-san's expression had returned to its usual sharp composure.
